model_name: UrjaSetu Urban Cooling & Heat Burden Priority Engine
task: 250m Spatial Grid Intervention Prioritization and Ensemble Thermal Cooling Prediction

sources.name: USGS Landsat 9 Collection 2 Level 2 Science Products (TIRS-2 Band 10)
sources.usage: Derivation of Land Surface Temperature (LST) and ST_QA uncertainty

sources.name: Copernicus Sentinel-2B MSI Level-2A BOA Reflectance (Bands B04 & B08)
sources.usage: Derivation of Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI)

sources.name: PMC Administrative Ward Boundaries & Master Register
sources.usage: Spatial ward aggregation and administrative boundary assignment

sources.name: OpenStreetMap Building Footprints & Road Network
sources.usage: Built-up surface fraction estimation and greenable land parcel screening

gate.criterion: Unconstrained Diagnostic Direction Gate (negative LST response to NDVI increase without monotone constraints)
gate.domain_description: Pune municipal 250m spatial grid; intervention domain restricts to greenable cells below target vegetation index (NDVI < 0.65)
gate.threshold_origin: Pre-registered municipal quality threshold (>= 95.0% unconstrained physical consistency across city grid)

direction_check.reason: Verified unconstrained diagnostic direction gate: 95.9% of cells exhibit negative LST response to NDVI increase without monotone constraints enforced (empirical cooling physics confirmed; 4.1% saturated vegetation excluded from intervention domain).

assumptions: Surface emissivity calibrated at ε ≈ 0.96 using ASTER GEDv3 broadband climatology.
Ambient resident population downscaled from 2022 WorldPop projections based on impervious built-up surface footprint density.
Municipal greening interventions target counterfactual vegetation index NDVI = 0.65 on available greenable land.
Rooftop solar PV thermal coupling uses assumed parameter α = 0.50 (sensitivity range 0.20 to 0.80).
Baseline Talegaon grassland reference station surface temperature is 32.1°C.
Ensemble spread reflects model parameter variance only; systematic observational calibration error is ±0.91°C (spatial-CV RMSE).
limitations: Surface temperature (LST) is not air temperature: Landsat 9 measures radiometric surface skin temperature, not 2-meter ambient air temperature or human physiological heat stress.
NDVI is not canopy cover: Sentinel-2 NDVI measures spectral chlorophyll reflectance (NIR-Red)/(NIR+Red), not 3D tree crown volume, canopy architecture, or physical shading.

Ensemble spread is model variance only: P10-P90 range reflects Monte Carlo parameter and sampling spread; systematic observational calibration error (spatial-CV RMSE = 0.91°C) must be considered separately.
Wards assignment: Administrative wards are approximate, assigned by nearest municipal ward-office centroid.
Population is Assumed: Ambient population is downscaled from 2022 WorldPop projections based on built-up density.
No arbitrary weighted composite scores: All prioritization rankings and cooling predictions are direct physical observations or unweighted empirical thermodynamic models.
Unknown values stay null and show 'Not available': Missing, unmeasured, or cloud-masked metrics are never fabricated or replaced with synthetic zero values.

Unconstrained Diagnostic Direction Gate: Verified unconstrained diagnostic direction gate: 95.9% of cells exhibit negative LST response to NDVI increase without monotone constraints enforced (empirical cooling physics confirmed; 4.1% saturated vegetation excluded from intervention domain).
Spatial scale: 250m grid scale aggregation; micro-scale parcel microclimates inside cell window are not resolved.
Temporal acquisition: Observations reflect clear-sky daytime conditions (~10:45 AM local solar time) and do not reflect nocturnal heat island dynamics.
